The '''Propaganda Dissemination Section''' was a government branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] responsible for the dissemination of [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]] served as the chief of the section for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During his tenure, Hax and the section were commissioned by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to write an article promoting the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], formerly Coruscant. The section stated that it presented the report verbatim without changing a single word from the original text.
